mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}::integer
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_bookmark (user_id, target_type, target_id, reg_dt, reg_ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}::integer, NOW(), #{regIp}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, target_type, target_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}::integer
mapper.select: SELECT bm.bookmark_id::TEXT AS db_key, bm.target_type, bm.target_id, b.title, b.bbsinfo_id, bi.bbsinfo_nm AS sub_nm, TO_CHAR(bm.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM t_bookmark bm JOIN t_bbs b ON b.bbs_id = bm.target_id AND b.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN t_bbsinfo bi ON bi.bbsinfo_id = b.bbsinfo_id WHERE bm.user_id = #{userId} AND bm.target_type = 'BBS' ORDER BY bm.bookmark_id DESC

SELECT bm.bookmark_id::TEXT AS db_key, bm.target_type, bm.target_id, r.title, ho.hobby_nm AS sub_nm, sc.code_nm AS status_nm, TO_CHAR(bm.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM t_bookmark bm JOIN t_recruit r ON r.recruit_id = bm.target_id AND r.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN t_hobby ho ON ho.hobby_id = r.hobby_id LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00' WHERE bm.user_id = #{userId} AND bm.target_type = 'RECRUIT' ORDER BY bm.bookmark_id DESC
SELECT target_id::TEXT FROM t_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_type = #{targetType}
